events.factual_description: The Hamilton Live and promoter All Good Presents list The Breaks for Friday, November 20, 2026, with doors at 6:30 PM and the show at 8:00 PM. The Breaks is the current trio of guitarist Eddie Roberts (The New Mastersounds), organist Robert Walter (The Greyboy Allstars) and drummer Stanton Moore (Galactic), with Gordon Sterling & The People supporting. The band's official site describes the project as rooted in late-1960s organ-trio soul-jazz and boogaloo, and its self-titled debut album was released in 2026.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the rhythm section as the entire architecture of the band: Eddie Roberts' clipped, melodic guitar, Robert Walter's Hammond language and Stanton Moore's New Orleans pocket compressed into a new working trio rather than assembled for a one-off all-star bill. Their 2026 debut gives the project its own repertoire and identity, rooted in organ-trio soul-jazz and boogaloo but built to leave room for improvisation. This is exactly the kind of groove-first musicianship that gets more interesting, not less, in a room the size of The Hamilton.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for this one in the DMV if deep pocket, Hammond organ and improvisational funk are part of the listening thread. The exact trio is the draw, but it is an active touring project with nearby dates, so there is flexibility rather than genuine scarcity.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para poner atención está en que la sección rítmica es toda la arquitectura de la banda: la guitarra recortada y melódica de Eddie Roberts, el lenguaje de Hammond de Robert Walter y el pocket de Nueva Orleans de Stanton Moore comprimidos en un trío de trabajo nuevo, no reunidos para un cartel de estrellas de una sola noche. Su debut de 2026 le da repertorio e identidad propios al proyecto, con raíces en soul-jazz de órgano y boogaloo pero suficiente espacio para improvisar. Es justo el tipo de música centrada en groove que se vuelve más interesante, no menos, en una sala del tamaño de The Hamilton.
es.trip_verdict: Vale hacerle espacio dentro del DMV si el pocket profundo, el Hammond y el funk improvisado forman parte del hilo de escucha. El atractivo es este trío exacto, pero es un proyecto activo con fechas cercanas, así que hay flexibilidad y no una escasez real.
